name: Admin Diagnostic Send Initial
description: Admin sends the initial-phase diagnostic from the edit page via 'Enviar envío inicial' — POST /api/diagnostics/:id/send-initial/, stamps `initial_sent_at`, status moves DRAFT → SENT. Public view then exposes only sections with visibility ∈ {initial, both}. The follow-up SENT → NEGOTIATING transition is its own flow (`admin-diagnostic-mark-in-analysis`). Since the Jul 2026 UX redesign the send opens a pre-send scorecard modal (GET /api/diagnostics/:id/scorecard/): blockers disable the send button and the backend refuses to transition while blockers remain (400 scorecard_blockers).
